title: How to Make Comparison Your Teacher

Visible success is usually the late result of invisible reps. The source is not asking the reader to become passive. The false takeaway is that every envy trigger means copying someone else. The real test is whether the desired outcome is changeable and genuinely wanted. If so, study the formula and work; if not, release the comparison as torture. Most desired outcomes, such as fitness, friendship, business growth, financial freedom, skill, reputation, or creativity, can be improved through time and consistent effort. Another person's win is not a personal loss; it often reveals a formula that can be studied.

The promise is a cleaner division between the part no one can force and the part the reader can choose now. The emotional temptation is to keep managing the result after the limit is already clear. Jealousy is strongest when the comparison target exposes work that has been avoided for years. implementationPlan.title: Comparison As Teacher Practice
implementationPlan.coreSkill: The skill is to notice the moment when attention leaves the reader's own choices and starts managing another person. In this source, comparison as teacher brings attention back to conduct, boundaries, requests, repair, or acceptance. The reader practices by naming the uncontrollable part and then choosing one honest action.

ifThenPlans.context: Molly and the neighborhood designer echo
ifThenPlans.plan: If a situation resembles Molly and the neighborhood designer, then pause before fixing the outcome and write the response that still belongs to you.
If a conversation starts to repeat Tom Brady on consistency, then speak one clear sentence and stop trying to force agreement.
If the replay keeps pulling attention back to another person's reaction, then return to the source's control split and take one observable action.
If harm, coercion, or safety is involved, then use the source's hard edge before practicing release.
